entities.name: Vanes Martirosyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vanes Norikovich Martirosyan was an Armenian-born American professional boxer who competed from 2005 to 2018. He challenged twice for a light middleweight world title in 2013 and 2016, and once for unified middleweight world titles in 2018.
